ModMetaData.name: RimWorld FPS Mode
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld FPS Mode contributors (fork of RimWorld x MW2 by rkwitz)
ModMetaData.description: Play your drafted colonists in first person, boomer shooter style: chunky pixels, a limited palette and RimWorld's own art standing in a Doom-like 3D view. RimWorld stays the game; the companion "boomer" client draws it. Needs the client from the project repo. Fork of RimWorld x MW2 by rkwitz, without Call of Duty.
